name: rosetta-maybe-monad-01-using-optional-types
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

unit[T](value: T) -> T? => value

>>=[T, U](value: T?, f: (T) -> U?) -> U? =>
    if value? then f(value) else null fi

halve(n: int) -> int? =>
    if n % 2 == 0 then n / 2 else null fi

describe(n: int) -> string? =>
    if n > 0 then "positive {n}" else null fi

show(n: int) =>
    write_line("{n}: {unit(n) >>= halve >>= describe ?? "nothing"}")

show(8)
show(7)
show(-4)
